# catalogue
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package catalogue is what the artist sells: products, their variants with prices and stock, and the tags that group them. It checks drafts, filters the list, stores products and draws the catalogue's screens.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `const MaximumSuggestions = 5` | MaximumSuggestions is how many tags the editor suggests at once. |
| `var TagColors = []TagColor{ ... }` | TagColors lists every tag colour, in the order TagColorFor picks from. |
| `var TagIconChoices = []string{ ... }` | TagIconChoices are the icons an artist can give a tag: kinds of work, tools and themes. |
| `func AdjustStockIn(rows storage.Querier, variantID string, delta int, at time.Time) error` | AdjustStockIn is AdjustStock inside a transaction other features are running: events take stock to a fair, sales take it from the catalogue. |
| `func DeliveryWords(days int) string` | DeliveryWords is how long a digital product takes to reach the buyer: «Al momento» when it is ready, or «7 días». |
| `func DistinctTagNames(names []string) []string` | DistinctTagNames drops blank names and repeated tags, keeping the first spelling of each. |
| `func Fold(text string) string` | Fold lowercases text and takes its accents off, so "Lámina" and "lamina" compare equal. |
| `func FormatCentimetres(millimetres int) string` | FormatCentimetres writes millimetres back as centimetres ("29,7", "30"). |
| `func Initial(name string) string` | Initial is the first letter of a product's name, drawn on its picture until it has a photo: the quoted title when there is one, so «Lámina «Gato»» gives G, not the L every print shares. |
| `func IsPhysicalIn(rows storage.Querier, variantID string) (bool, error)` | IsPhysicalIn tells whether a variant belongs to a physical product, inside a transaction. |
| `func KindWords(kind Kind, tags []string) string` | KindWords is what a product is, as its editor says it: its first tag and the kind, which agrees with it ("Llavero físico", "Pegatina física"), or the kind alone ("Físico", "Digital"). |
| `func ListFill(position int) draw2d.Color` | ListFill is the colour of the picture at position in a list, on either theme. |
| `func ParseCentimetres(text string) (millimetres int, found bool)` | ParseCentimetres reads centimetres with at most one decimal ("29,7") as millimetres (297). |
| `func ParseCount(text string) (count int, found bool)` | ParseCount reads a whole number of units, such as stock; found is false for anything else. |
| `func PictureFill(name string) draw2d.Color` | PictureFill is the colour of the picture of a work called name: the same work always gets the same one. |
| `func Plural(name string) string` | Plural is the Spanish plural of a tag's name, for the tab that groups it: «Lámina» gives «Láminas», «Llavero» «Llaveros», «Imán» «Imanes» and «Lápiz» «Lápices». |
| `func PriceRangeWords(product Product) string` | PriceRangeWords is "8 €", or "8 – 15 €" from the cheapest variant to the dearest. |
| `func PriceWords(product Product) string` | PriceWords is "8 €", or "desde 8 €" when the variants have different prices. |
| `func ProblemWords(problem Problem) string` | ProblemWords is what the artist reads about a problem of a draft. |
| `func Restock(products []Product) []string` | Restock lists what needs restocking, as the artist says it: "A3 de Gato astronauta" for a version, "Luna" for a product with a single one. |
| `func SoldWords(units int) string` | SoldWords says how many times a product sold this month: «Vendido 8 veces este mes». |
| `func StockIn(rows storage.Querier, variantID string) (stock int, found bool, err error)` | StockIn is Stock, read inside a transaction other features are running. |
| `func StockWords(product Product) string` | StockWords is a physical product's stock in a few words. |
| `func SummaryWords(product Product) string` | SummaryWords is the kind, with the number of variants when there is more than one. |
| `func TagDisplayName(raw string) string` | TagDisplayName trims a tag's name and joins its inner spaces into one, keeping the casing typed. |
| `func TagIcon(name string) string` | TagIcon is the icon of a tag: one for the kinds of work an artist usually sells, in the singular or the plural, and a plain tag for the rest. |
| `func TagKey(raw string) string` | TagKey is what makes two tags the same: "pokemon ", "Pokémon" and "POKEMON" share one key. |
| `func TagTone(theme ui.Theme, color TagColor) look.Tone` | TagTone is the tone of a tag colour in the theme being drawn. |
| `type Code string` | Code is a stable name for what went wrong, for programs to check and people to search for. |
| `const CodeBlankName Code = "catalogue.blank-name" ...` | Error codes of this package. |
| `type Error struct{ ... }` | Error is a failure of the catalogue: its code and what it was about. |
| `type Kind string` | Kind is one of the two kinds of product the artist sells. |
| `const Physical Kind = "PHYSICAL" ...` | The kinds of product. |
| `type Problem struct{ ... }` | Problem is one reason a draft cannot be saved. |
| `func Validate(product Product) []Problem` | Validate lists every problem of a draft; none means it can be saved. |
| `type Product struct{ ... }` | Product is anything the artist sells. |
| `func Filter(products []Product, query Query) []Product` | Filter keeps the products that match every part of the query, in the order they come: the store gives them oldest first, so a new work goes to the end, where the artist expects it. |
| `type ProductDraft struct{ ... }` | ProductDraft is what the editor saves: the product as the artist left it, the tags by their names, and the stock each variant had when the editor opened (StockBaseline), so stock that moved elsewhere meanwhile is kept. |
| `type Query struct{ ... }` | Query is the search and the filters the artist applies to the catalogue. |
| `type Screens struct{ ... }` | Screens are the catalogue's pages: the list, and the editor of one product over it. |
| `func NewScreens(store *Store, newID func() string) *Screens` | NewScreens draws the catalogue kept in store. |
| `type Status string` | Status is where a product is in its life in the catalogue. |
| `const Draft Status = "DRAFT" ...` | The statuses of a product. |
| `type Store struct{ ... }` | Store keeps the catalogue in the database. |
| `func NewStore(database *storage.Database, now func() time.Time, newID func() string) *Store` | NewStore keeps the catalogue in database, telling the time with now and making ids with newID; tests pass fixed ones. |
| `type Tag struct{ ... }` | Tag is a free label (a theme, a fandom, a fair) that groups and filters products. |
| `func SuggestTags(all []Tag, chosenNames []string, typed string) []Tag` | SuggestTags picks the tags not chosen yet whose name holds what is typed; with nothing typed, any tags not chosen yet. |
| `type TagColor string` | TagColor is one of the fixed colours tags are painted with; the screens turn each into real colours for the light and the dark theme. |
| `const Rose TagColor = "ROSE" ...` | The tag colours. |
| `func TagColorFor(key string) TagColor` | TagColorFor picks a colour from a tag's key, always the same one for the same key. |
| `type Variant struct{ ... }` | Variant is a version of a product that is sold on its own (a size, a format, a level of detail), with its own price and cost. |
